thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered — HIGH error rate (5xx) on /api/v1/generate in prod-us-east-1. alert_id=PD12345 :fire:

sam_oncall: I'm paged — joining. seeing ~25% 5xx on NGINX ingress in the last 5m. :eyes:

maria_sre: confirmed on metrics. spike started ~14:02 UTC. top peer is edge-gateway-prod returning 504/502s.

devon_platform: can you paste the query you used? pulling logs now.

sam_oncall: Prom query i ran:```sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api-prod\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api-prod\"}[5m])) * 100``` shows 5xx_rate ~25% for /api/v1/generate path.

maria_sre: logs show upstream timeout errors: `upstream timed out (110)` and `502 upstream read error` for requests proxied to edge-proxy-12.

devon_platform: on call with edge-proxy team, they're seeing increased latency to provider cluster apigw-1. can we failover traffic?

sam_oncall: two-pronged mitigation: 1) flip feature flag to reduce burst size for generation endpoint, 2) add temporary routing to us-west pool for new requests. doing flag now.

alex_product: pinging product — any active customers running extremely long contexts that would amplify failures?

sam_oncall: quick note — clients using streaming + large contexts spike connection counts; reducing max concurrency should help.

maria_sre: I pushed a dashboard filter to show 5xx by upstream and path. added a temp panel "5xx by upstream (5m window)".

devon_platform: routing change in progress — shifting 15% traffic to us-west as a fallback. will monitor.

incident-bot: Status update: mitigation applied (flag toggled, traffic shifted). severity -> acknowledged.

sam_oncall: initial customer impact: ~1% of requests failing end-to-end for ~30 minutes for a subset of users hitting that path. Escalations: 0 confirmed customer-facing incidents so far.

maria_sre: i'm going to propose alert tuning post-incident — current alert fires on 5xx_rate > 1% (5m window) which caused noisy pages for transient upstream blips.

sam_oncall: agree. Proposed changes: 1) bump threshold to 3% for the global 5xx alert, 2) require 2 out of 3 evaluation windows (i.e., 3m within 10m) before paging, 3) add upstream-specific alerts for edge-proxy and apigw-1 to target real provider failures.

maria_sre: also add a short suppression rule for spikes <2m to avoid paging on short-lived flapping.

devon_platform: +1. For the gateway errors (502/504) we should split alerting by code class: 502/504 -> escalate faster; 5xx others -> info only. we can add an alert for `rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"50[24]\"}[5m])` with lower threshold but only notify Ops after 3m sustained.

sam_oncall: I'll open a post-incident ticket with the action items: change thresholds, add upstream panels, and create runbook snippet for transient upstream failures. tagging @alex_product to coordinate customer comms if needed.

alex_product: thanks — if we end up needing a customer advisory I'll coordinate wording. for now let's track customers with increased error rates and add to the ticket.

maria_sre: created ticket RW-INC-879 in backlog and added checklist: 
- update global 5xx alert threshold to 3% (5m) with 2/3 evals
- add suppression for <2m spikes
- new dashboard tile: 5xx by upstream + path
- create alert variant for 502/504 with expedited paging rules
- add runbook section: "Upstream provider degradation" with steps to shift traffic/fallbacks

sam_oncall: handoff: my shift ends in 18m, i'll leave devon as primary; ping me if traffic reverts.

devon_platform: takeover ack. monitoring traffic now — current 5xx_rate down to ~4% and trending down after the routing shift.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff recorded (sam_oncall -> devon_platform).

maria_sre: postmortem notes: root cause probable transient overload to apigw-1 causing upstream timeouts. long-term action: add upstream capacity checks and SLIs for upstream latency.

sam_oncall: final: opened PR in ops/alerts repo with proposed threshold changes and added dashboard tiles. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/alerts/pull/789

devon_platform: will follow up tomorrow to finalize alert rules and coordinate with edge-proxy team for hardening. good work team. :thumbsup:
